es: Contar una conversación diferenciando afirmaciones, preguntas, promesas y advertencias, con al menos cuatro verbos de reporte distintos.

teaching.en: I want to retell the conversation I had with Ana yesterday.
teaching.es: Quiero volver a contar la conversación que tuve ayer con Ana.
teaching.explanationEs: Retell: contar lo que se dijo, en orden y con tus palabras.
segments: I want to retell the conversation
teaching.audioText: I want to retell the conversation I had with Ana yesterday.

teaching.en: Ana told me that she had lost her phone, and afterwards she asked me if I could help.
teaching.es: Ana me dijo que había perdido el móvil y después me preguntó si podía ayudarla.
teaching.explanationEs: Told me that es una afirmación; asked me if es una pregunta, con orden normal (I could help).
segments: Ana told me that she had lost her phone,
and afterwards she asked me if I could help.
teaching.audioText: Ana told me that she had lost her phone, and afterwards she asked me if I could help.

teaching.en: I promised to help her, but I warned her not to worry too much.
teaching.es: Le prometí ayudarla, pero le advertí que no se preocupara demasiado.
teaching.explanationEs: Promised to: promesa. Warned her not to: advertencia en negativo.
segments: I promised to help her, but I
warned her not to worry too much.
teaching.audioText: I promised to help her, but I warned her not to worry too much.

teaching.en: She complained that her brother never returned her things.
teaching.es: Se quejó de que su hermano nunca le devolvía sus cosas.
teaching.explanationEs: Complained that: una queja sobre algo que molesta.
teaching.audioText: She complained that her brother never returned her things.

teaching.en: Finally, she mentioned that her brother had found the phone under the sofa.
teaching.es: Por último, mencionó que su hermano había encontrado el móvil debajo del sofá.
teaching.explanationEs: Mentioned that: añade un dato sin darle demasiada importancia.
segments: Finally, she mentioned that her brother had
found the phone under the sofa.
teaching.audioText: Finally, she mentioned that her brother had found the phone under the sofa.

teaching.en: At the end of the conversation, Ana told me that the shop closes at six.
teaching.es: Al final de la conversación, Ana me dijo que la tienda cierra a las seis.
teaching.explanationEs: Si lo dicho sigue siendo cierto (la tienda cierra todos los días a las seis), puedes dejar el presente.
segments: At the end of the conversation, Ana told
me that the shop closes at six.
teaching.audioText: At the end of the conversation, Ana told me that the shop closes at six.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo se reporta correctamente la pregunta de Ana?

choices.text: Ana asked me if could I help her.
Ana asked me that I could help her.
Ana asked me if I could help her.

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada usa if y el orden de una afirmación: I could help. Las otras dos invierten el orden o usan that.

hint.es: En una pregunta reportada el orden es el de una afirmación.

origin.text: «Could you help me, please?» asked Ana.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me advirtió que no se lo contara a nadie.»

feedback.es: Warned me not to + verbo base: el negativo va antes de to.

hint.es: El negativo de warned me to va antes del to.

origin.text: She warned me ___ to tell anyone.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Leo me dijo que había perdido sus llaves.»

answer.text: Leo told me that he had lost his keys

feedback.es: Told me that + oración, con el verbo un paso atrás (had lost).

hint.es: Empieza con quién habló y a quién, y sigue con that.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dos actos de habla debes reportar.

choices.text: The speaker apologised and made a promise.
The speaker complained and gave a warning.
The speaker asked a question and made an offer.

feedback.es: Se disculpa (sorry) y promete no repetirlo: dos actos de habla. No hay queja ni pregunta.

origin.audio: She said she was sorry for being late and promised not to do it again.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reporte recoge bien el mensaje de Tom?

choices.text: Tom asked did I finish the report, and he said he needs it tomorrow.
Tom asked if I had finished the report, and he said he needed it the next day.
Tom asked that I finish the report, and he said he needed it the next day.

feedback.es: Asked if + orden normal + retroceso de tiempo; tomorrow pasa a the next day. Las otras invierten el orden o usan that.

origin.text: Tom's message: «Did you finish the report? I need it tomorrow.»

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase original con el verbo de reporte que debes usar.

pairs: I will pay you back on Friday.

feedback.es: Cada acto de habla pide su verbo: promesa, advertencia, pregunta y queja.

pairs: I will pay you back on Friday.

choices.text: Ana said she is late because the bus breaks down, Leo asked if was she coming, and she promised to come at eight.
Ana told that she was late, Leo asked her to come to the party, and she promised coming at eight.
Ana said she was late because the bus had broken down, Leo asked if she was coming, and she promised to come at eight.

feedback.es: La versión correcta retrocede los tiempos, reporta la pregunta con if y orden normal y usa promised to. Las demás tienen inversión, tiempos sin retroceso o patrones mal formados.

origin.text: Ana: «I'm late because the bus broke down.» Leo: «Are you coming to the party?» Ana: «I promise I'll come at eight.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pregunta se reporta.

choices.text: Whether they could come early.
Where the concert was.
Why the concert was on Saturday.

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada es asked if we could arrive early. La fecha del concierto es una afirmación, no una pregunta.

origin.audio: Mr Reyes told us that the concert was on Saturday. Then he asked if we could arrive early.

prompt.es: Completa: «Leo mencionó que la tienda cerraba a las seis.»

feedback.es: Mentioned that + oración añade un dato, con el verbo un paso atrás.

origin.text: Leo ___ that the shop closed at six.

prompt.es: Cuenta la conversación en orden, con un verbo de reporte distinto para cada frase.

answer.text: Ana told Leo that she was tired. He asked her if she wanted to rest, and she promised to sleep early. Then he warned her not to use her phone in bed, and she complained that the neighbours made a lot of noise. Finally, she mentioned that the shop closes at six.
accepted: Ana told Leo that she was tired. He asked her if she wanted to rest, and she promised to sleep early. Then he warned her not to use her phone in bed, and she complained that the neighbours made a lot of noise. Finally, she mentioned that the shop closes at six.

Ana said that she was tired. Leo asked her whether she wanted to rest, and she promised to sleep early. Afterwards, he warned her not to use her phone in bed, and she complained that the neighbors made a lot of noise. Finally, she mentioned that the shop closes at six.

Ana told Leo that she was tired. He asked if she wanted to rest, and she promised to go to bed early. Then he warned her not to use her phone in bed, and she complained that the neighbours were very noisy. Finally, she mentioned that the shop closed at six.

feedback.es: Cada acto de habla lleva su verbo: told/said (afirmación), asked if (pregunta), promised to (promesa), warned not to (advertencia), complained that (queja) y mentioned that (dato); la tienda sigue cerrando a las seis, así que el presente es válido.

origin.text: Datos: Ana dijo que estaba cansada; Leo le preguntó si quería descansar; ella prometió dormir temprano; él le advirtió que no usara el móvil en la cama; ella se quejó de que los vecinos hacían mucho ruido; por último, mencionó que la tienda cierra a las seis.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo cuenta quien reporta la pregunta de Sara?

choices.text: Sara asked Leo why was he angry with her.
Sara asked Leo why he was angry with her.
Sara asked Leo that he was angry with her.

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada mantiene el orden normal (he was) y sin signo de pregunta. Las otras invierten el orden o usan that.

origin.text: «Why are you angry with me?» Sara asked Leo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué acto hay que reportar.

choices.text: A promise.
A complaint.
A warning.

feedback.es: Avisa de una consecuencia negativa si no se actúa: es una advertencia, así que el verbo es warned.

origin.audio: If you don't leave now, you will miss the bus!

prompt.es: Ordena: «Sara mencionó que había encontrado las llaves.»

answer.text: Sara mentioned that she had found the keys

feedback.es: Mentioned that + oración, con el verbo un paso atrás (had found).
